reference: net-tools hostname (Debian), run in the same isolated UTS namespace (host name 'parity').

cases.purpose: G74: --short and its prefixes print the host name up to the first dot.
G74: --yp/--nis (-y) report an unset NIS domain the way net-tools hostname does.
cases.script: { hostname --nis || echo rc=$?; } 2>&1 | sed 's/^fixture: line [0-9]*: //'; { hostname -y || echo rc=$?; } 2>&1 | sed 's/^fixture: line [0-9]*: //'

cases.purpose: G74: -b/--boot with no name prints the current name.
